summary: Diff implements several UI consistency primitives (PageShell/PageHeader, LoadingState, EmptyStateCard/ErrorStateCard), refactors rental status/date presentation into shared utilities, updates multiple pages/components to use these patterns, and adjusts global theme variables. However, some requirements appear only partially met: not all pages/routes are evidenced as updated, map zoom logic appears duplicated (useMapZoom introduced while CommunityMap uses useMapTransform), and several changes introduce new photo/camera functionality that is not part of the requested polish/refactor scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure every route defined in frontend/src/App.tsx uses a consistent page header pattern (title + optional subtitle) and consistent top/bottom padding.
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows PageShell/PageHeader adoption in several pages (Browse, Messaging, MyRentals, MyTools, Requests, Profile, CommunityMap), but the diff summary does not provide evidence that all routes/pages (e.g., Landing page) were updated to use the same pattern.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (mentioned in frontend-file-summaries.txt, but page-by-page coverage not shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: All pages that load data show a consistent loading UI and a consistent empty state (card/panel styling, aligned CTA button styles).
missing_requirements.reason: Some loading/empty states are standardized via LoadingState/EmptyStateCard, but at least one empty-state-like UI remains custom (CommunityMapPage's "No Members Yet" block uses bespoke markup rather than EmptyStateCard). Also RentalChatPanel still uses inline loading/error/empty markup rather than the shared state components.

missing_requirements.requirement: Consolidate map zoom/pan interaction logic into one hook (no overlapping/duplicated implementations across hooks).
missing_requirements.reason: useMapZoom.ts is implemented, but CommunityMapPanel uses a different hook (useMapTransform). Based on the diff, both hooks appear to coexist, which suggests zoom-related logic is not consolidated into a single hook as required.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced camera capture/photo reference management functionality for listing forms (camera UI, data URL conversion, photo management field).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly scoped to UI polish/refactor and avoiding new product features; camera capture for photos appears to add new end-user functionality rather than just polish/refactor.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/mentioned a new /community-map route in App.tsx.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals/constraints state not to add new routes beyond those already present in frontend/src/App.tsx. The diff summary claims routing includes a new /community-map route; if it was not previously present, this would violate scope. (Cannot confirm previous state from diff alone, but the change is explicitly described as new.)
